content:
jordan: quick huddle on proxy hedging + tenant-weighting. moving towards smarter local admission but want a smoothing/hedge layer so proxies don't oscillate when controller updates weights. sketching ideas here.

neha: tl;dr: proxies should accept a stream of weight deltas and apply a smoothing kernel, not immediate hard switches. otherwise a single reweight event causes huge ripples.

jordan: exactly. two components: (1) weight ingestion/commit protocol (controller -> proxy) and (2) runtime smoothing + hedging fallback.

sam: for the ingestion protocol, can we piggyback on existing reservation/events stream? we already have reservations.v1 so maybe weights.v1 topic with versioned snapshots. proxies subscribe and ack.

infra-bot: event-stream: weights.v1 created, partitioned by region.

ryan: design trade: either send deltas or full snapshots. deltas are smaller but proxies need to reconstruct state and handle out-of-order. snapshots simpler and idempotent. i'm leaning snapshots every N seconds plus deltas for hot changes.

neha: snapshots every 30s, deltas for VIP changes makes sense. snapshots should include an epoch id and monotonic counter. proxies ignore older epochs.

jordan: runtime smoothing: propose a modular config applied per-tenant-group: smoothing_window_ms, hedge_threshold_pct, emergency_fallback. sample YAML:
```yaml
proxy.smoothing:
  default:
    smoothing_window_ms: 5000
    kernel: exponential
    hedge_threshold_pct: 0.25 # if demand deviates >25% vs smoothed -> hedge
    emergency_fallback: local-reservoir # options: local-reservoir, hard-drop
  vip:
    smoothing_window_ms: 1000
    hedge_threshold_pct: 0.5
```

sam: what does hedging mean here?

jordan: hedging = when proxy detects demand spike > hedge_threshold compared to smoothed estimate, it temporarily routes extra requests to a fallback path that is slower but rate-limited centrally or to a degraded model. gives controller time to recompute weights and issue a reservation snapshot.

ryan: fallback examples: 1) route to a quantized cheaper model 2) short-circuit to cached responses 3) push to a central admission queue with fair scheduling. need operator knobs.

neha: abuse detection: if tenant repeatedly triggers hedges, mark as "recurrent-burst" and escalate to abuse pipeline. but must avoid false positives during legit campaigns. add cooldown windows and require two independent signals (hedge_count > N and sustained high token-cost-per-request).

jordan: telemetry to detect issues:
- proxy_smoothed_demand{tenant} = the smoothed rate series
- proxy_instant_rate{tenant} = raw rate
- hedges_triggered_total{proxy,tenant}
- tenant_token_cost_rate = sum(rate(token_cost_total[5m])) by (tenant) / sum(rate(requests[5m])) by (tenant)

sam: promql examples:
- sudden_spike = increase(proxy_instant_rate{tenant="T"}[10s]) / avg_over_time(proxy_smoothed_demand{tenant="T"}[5m]) > 0.25
- recurrent_hedge = increase(hedges_triggered_total{tenant="T"}[1h]) > 3 and tenant_token_cost_rate{tenant="T"} > 10

neha: rollout plan:
1) emit weights.v1 snapshots into Kafka for internal region only
2) deploy proxy consumer in canary that only logs smoothing decisions (no fallback)
3) enable fallback hedging for internal tenants behind a feature flag
4) iterate on tuning and then expand to public tenants with billing-tag gating

ryan: performance note: smoothing requires additional per-tenant state in proxy (sliding windows). memory cost ~ 100 bytes per active tenant * ~active_tenants_per_proxy. need to cap and LRU cold tenants. also ensure GC of ephemeral tenants.

jordan: agree. add a tenant-state cap and a decay policy: state_ttl_ms and min_sample_count. config idea: state_cap: 10000, state_ttl_ms: 600000.

sam: security: weight snapshots signed with rotating key; proxies validate epoch and signature. also audit logged to weights.audit topic for postmortems.

neha: on billing: since hedging might route VIPs to reserved capacity, we need to surface cost attribution. suggestion: reservation metadata include weight_origin and applied_epoch so billing can map to snapshots.

infra-bot: bench-job scheduled: proxy-smoothing-bench-2024-07-19 at 2024-07-19T02:00Z

jordan: tests to run: mixed tenant mix 1000 tenants, 5% VIP, inject N bursts, measure percent of hedging events, p50/p95/p99 request latency delta, and fairness_score = coefficient_of_variation of per-tenant token-served-rate across tenants over 5m.

neha: also test clock skew: proxies must tolerate up to 2s clock drift otherwise hedges might misfire. add metric: snapshot_lag = now() - snapshot_commit_ts. alert if > 2s.

ryan: one more edge: rolling key rotation for signature verification. proxies should cache previous key for grace period to avoid mass validation failures during rotation. metric: signature_mismatch_rate.

jordan: I'll draft a playbook with: ingestion protocol doc, smoothing config defaults, telemetry queries + alerts, bench plan, and abuse escalation flow. will post RFC follow-up PR.

neha: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

infra-bot: ticket INFRA-4422 created: "proxy smoothing + hedging playbook" assigned to @jordan

jordan: thanks. if anyone has subtle corner-cases (multi-proxy fanout, regional failover) ping me. planning to include a fallback matrix in the PR.
